content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad, Stripe, and similar platforms provide user-friendly interfaces for selling digital goods, but they come with a catch. These platforms primarily serve users in well-supported countries, leaving many creators without options. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack offers robust infrastructure that bypasses conventional barriers. It combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to create a fully operational online store without the constraints imposed by geographic limitations. This architecture allows creators to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products freely and efficiently.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Stripe are notorious for excluding users in certain countries, effectively preventing access to their services. Stripe's limited footprint means creators in regions like Nigeria or Pakistan cannot utilize its payment processing capabilities. Furthermore, PayPal can suspend accounts for up to 180 days, freezing funds without recourse. COREMERCH’s solution circumvents these restrictions entirely. By leveraging decentralized payment options through NOWPayments, creators can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies without worrying about geographical limitations or account freezes.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed, fees, and overall costs can significantly vary among platforms. Stripe may offer quick deposits, but high transaction fees and geographic restrictions can negate those benefits for many users. PayPal's fee structure can also be cumbersome, particularly with potential account suspensions. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack utilizes NOWPayments, which offers a low fee of only 0.5% and supports quick transactions across various cryptocurrencies. This setup allows creators to maintain more of their earnings while ensuring instant payment confirmations and delivery of digital products.
Complete ownership means no more account freezes or suspensions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital assets is often overlooked when utilizing conventional platforms. When using Gumroad or PayPal, creators risk losing access to their funds and customer lists if accounts are restricted or suspended. COREMERCH guarantees complete ownership after deployment; creators retain full control over their stores and customer data. Additionally, the Edge Commerce Stack automates payment processing and product delivery, ensuring that once a purchase is made, the product is delivered instantly without manual intervention, bolstering creator autonomy.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on the specific needs of the creator. If you require simplicity and fast deployment, COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack is a viable option. However, for those needing more complexity and automation, the Edge Commerce Stack provides a comprehensive solution. It is deployed in just 48 hours, with full infrastructure support and end-to-end testing. Evaluate your specific requirements and consider long-term viability when deciding on a commerce stack.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, the best alternative is to use a sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH. This setup allows you to sell digital products without the constraints of traditional payment processors. With tools like NOWPayments, you can accept crypto payments quickly and reliably, ensuring you remain in control of your business.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
